newsitem.title: IRAQ: Saddam to make speech on Gulf War anniversary.
newsitem.headline: Saddam to make speech on Gulf War anniversary.

text.p: Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein will on Friday make a speech to mark the sixth anniversary of the start of the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait, the official Iraqi News Agency INA said on Thursday.

"President Saddam Hussein will deliver a comprehensive national speech to the sons of Iraq and those of the Arab nations at 11.00 A.M. (0800 GMT) on Friday on the occasion of the sixth anniversay of the 30-nation military aggression on Iraq," INA said.
The agency said the speech would be carried by all Iraqi television and radio satations.
A U.S.-led coalition launched an air offensive on Iraqi forces on January 17, 1991 following Iraq's August 1990 invasion of Kuwait.
